name: fhir-questionnaire-kit
description: Monorepo for @fhirq/*: render a FHIR R4 Questionnaire, emit a valid QuestionnaireResponse

scripts.typecheck: tsc --build --force tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/browser && tsc -p packages/react/test/browser
scripts.test:browser: playwright test --project react-chromium --project react-webkit --project chromium --project webkit
scripts.api:check: tsc --build packages/core packages/react && api-extractor run -c packages/core/api-extractor.json && api-extractor run -c packages/core/api-extractor.view.json && api-extractor run -c packages/core/api-extractor.resume.json && api-extractor run -c packages/react/api-extractor.json
scripts.api:update: tsc --build packages/core packages/react && api-extractor run --local -c packages/core/api-extractor.json && api-extractor run --local -c packages/core/api-extractor.view.json && api-extractor run --local -c packages/core/api-extractor.resume.json && api-extractor run --local -c packages/react/api-extractor.json
